concerns.text: FR-007 requires a sensitivity sweep over 'descriptor thresholds' (numerical cutoffs), but T031 implements a sweep over 'percentiles of importance distribution' (ranking-based). The task description lacks logic to vary actual numerical descriptor cutoffs, leaving FR-007 unimplemented.

Constitution Principle VI mandates identical molecular geometries for all electronic structure calculations to ensure valid comparison. T013 (DFTB+) and T020 (Psi4) describe independent geometry optimizations without a mechanism to enforce shared geometry inputs, leaving the constitutional requirement unaddressed.

Spec Edge Cases mandate 'Skip molecule, log failure, continue' for validation issues. T053 enforces strict structural constraints and 'Fail molecules violating these invariants,' which contradicts the spec's instruction to skip rather than halt/fail the pipeline, leaving the edge case handling unimplemented as specified.

FR-003 requires computing DFT descriptors for a 'subset' to train a comparative model. T020 states subset size is 'determined by available data... no arbitrary minimum,' risking an empty or insufficient subset for Random Forest training (FR-004), leaving the functional intent of FR-003 unguaranteed.

T055 (FLOP counting) and T056 (missing degrees of freedom) introduce tasks not traceable to any FR/SC in spec.md. While potentially useful, they lack requirement tags or descriptions linking them to a specific spec element, creating stale/unanchored task entries.

T054 and T057 introduce 'physical interpretability' and 'observable mapping' reports to satisfy simulated reviewer personas. These tasks lack explicit tags or descriptions linking them to a specific FR/SC in spec.md (US3 only requires sensitivity sweep), creating stale/unanchored task entries.
